questions.question: What's true about wp_loaded that's NOT true about init?

options.label: It fires before any plugin code runs
It fires only after every init callback (core, plugins, and theme) has already finished
It's the right place to register post types

feedback.correct: Right. wp_loaded runs after all init callbacks finished, so it's the safe spot to read things other plugins registered on init (like checking a CPT exists).
feedback.incorrect: wp_loaded runs after every init callback (core + plugins + theme) has finished — that's what makes it safe to read what others registered on init. Registering things there yourself is usually too late, e.g. rewrite rules for a CPT won't be ready this request.
